name: NetBox
description: Infrastructure resource modeling tool for network, IPAM, and hardware asset documentation.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      DB_NAME: netbox
      DB_USER: netbox
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/media:/opt/netbox/netbox/media
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: netbox
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: netbox
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
